items.title: Appear as witness at court hearing
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date and time for the court hearing the witness must attend: Donnerstag, 25.03.2027, 10:30 Uhr, at Amtsgericht Musterdal, Sitzungssaal 2 (1. OG). No period calculation is needed; the date is printed directly.

warnings: This is a formal witness summons under § 380 ZPO: failure to appear without sufficient excuse can result in the costs of the failed hearing being charged to the witness and a fine (Ordnungsgeld) being imposed — bring a photo ID and this letter to the hearing.

The witness may claim compensation for travel costs and loss of earnings under the JVEG (Justiz-Vergütungs- und -Entschädigungsgesetz); no amount is stated in the letter itself, so none is listed under amounts.
